decision: The initial investigation recorded actual press/update/payment/trigger/payload execution. The accepted exporter additionally samples the live cost, stage-limit and spark-bonus inputs after actor timers. Removing these input observations reproduces the initial data exactly; no expected gameplay outcome was revised.
observations: Original exports repeat byte-identically and match the preceding v0.19 game adapter.
The local source prototype matches all 144 transitions; package integration remains a separate acceptance check.
Standalone per-update comparisons rehydrate original state; they do not by themselves demonstrate a continuous cast lifecycle.
The original charge mode invokes delivery on a death-ended hold; overcharge suppresses it. This difference is preserved, not silently repaired.
scope: Charge/overcharge preparation durations and admitted update phase. Shared gates, aim/AI, interruption cleanup, initial payment, resource debt, cooldown clocks and delivery remain explicit host responsibilities.
